channel.title: PAGASA NCRPRSD Advisories
channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA NCRPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 3:00 PM, 21 August 2026(Friday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Nueva Ecija(Pantabangan, Palayan, Cabanatuan, Llanera, Rizal, Laur, Bongabon, Talavera, San Jose, Santa Rosa, General Mamerto Natividad) within the next 3 hours.

Heavy to intense rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in Tarlac(Tarlac City) which may persist within 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 9 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 9-Final #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 20 August 2026(Thursday)

All Rainfall Advisory over NCR-PRSD forecast area are now TERMINATED.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 2:25 PM, 20 August 2026(Thursday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Rizal(Rodriguez, Antipolo, Tanay) and Quezon(General Nakar, Panukulan, Burdeos) within the next 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Miguel) and Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, Lupao, Carranglan, San Jose, Pantabangan) which may persist within 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
